qbi_deduction.citation: IRS Qualified Business Income Deduction page describes the Section 199A deduction as up to 20% of QBI and subject to taxable-income, W-2 wage, UBIA, and business-type limitations. Rev. Proc. 2024-40 sets 2025 taxable-income thresholds and upper phase-in range amounts for Section 199A.
qbi_deduction.notes: Below the taxable-income threshold, the core QBI deduction can be modeled as the lesser of 20% of qualified business income or 20% of taxable income minus net capital gain. Above the threshold and through the upper limit, W-2 wage, UBIA, and SSTB phase-in rules require business-specific inputs. Above the upper limit, those limitations fully apply. This data file stores thresholds only; high-income phase-out logic must be modeled in a later engine step and must not be presented as precise without W-2 wage, UBIA, and SSTB inputs.
qbi_deduction.rev_proc_2024_40_status_mapping_note: Rev. Proc. 2024-40 lists Section 199A rows for Married Filing Jointly, Married Filing Separately, and All Other Returns. single, head_of_household, and qualifying_surviving_spouse are mapped to All Other Returns.
